description:
## Goal
Move the `MAX_GRAY_ATTEMPTS = 3` constant from `Fetcher::LoopState` to `Vug::GrayPlaceholderHandler`, where the gray-placeholder policy actually lives.

## Why (SRP)
`LoopState` is a generic fetch-loop state container. It currently carries a `gray_placeholder_attempts` counter and a `MAX_GRAY_ATTEMPTS = 3` cap. Both are gray-placeholder concerns:
- The counter is only ever incremented in the `TryFallback` branch, which is gray-placeholder-specific.
- The cap is checked in `check_termination` with a `Too many gray placeholder attempts` error.
- The actual fallback URL strategy lives in `GrayPlaceholderHandler`.

Placing the cap in `GrayPlaceholderHandler` (alongside the existing `DDG_DEFAULT_ICON_SIZE`, `GOOGLE_FAVICON_SIZE`) keeps gray-placeholder policy in one file and lets `LoopState` stay domain-neutral.

## Approach
1. In `src/vug/gray_placeholder_handler.cr`, add:
   ```crystal
   MAX_FALLBACK_ATTEMPTS = 3
   ```
   (or a more descriptive name; the existing comment says "3 attempts" so keep the value.)
2. In `src/vug/fetcher.cr`:
   - Remove the `MAX_GRAY_ATTEMPTS = 3` constant from `LoopState`.
   - Update `check_termination` to reference `GrayPlaceholderHandler::MAX_FALLBACK_ATTEMPTS` (or the chosen name).
3. No change to `LoopState`'s `gray_placeholder_attempts` field — it stays as a counter; only the cap moves.

## Acceptance
- `MAX_GRAY_ATTEMPTS` no longer exists in `LoopState`.
- The cap is referenced from one place (`check_termination`) and defined in `GrayPlaceholderHandler`.
- The default value (3) is unchanged, so existing behavior is preserved.
- All fetcher and gray_placeholder_handler specs pass.

## Notes
- The chosen name (`MAX_FALLBACK_ATTEMPTS` here) is a suggestion; the final name is up to the implementer as long as it lives in `GrayPlaceholderHandler`.
title: Move MAX_GRAY_ATTEMPTS into GrayPlaceholderHandler
